einzeiler: Bruce Campbell and Paula Poundstone join John Lovett live from Hollywood.
kurzfassung: John Lovett hosts a live show from Hollywood with guests Bruce Campbell and Paula Poundstone. The episode covers current political headlines, a game comparing romance and horror plots, and discussions about acting careers and late-night television memories. The broadcast concludes with comedic rants and a segment reflecting on earlier jokes.
stichpunkte: Discussion of political headlines including J.D. Vance and Ted Cruz
A comedic look at bizarre news items, from plant-based drug framing to tiger driver's license suspensions
Bruce Campbell discusses his new film Ernie and Emma and his history with the Evil Dead franchise
Playing a game called Dead Meat Cute distinguishing rom-coms from horror movies
Paula Poundstone joins the stage to discuss her daily pogo stick countdown and early Tonight Show memories with Johnny Carson
A rant wheel segment featuring comedic complaints about bike paths and daily annoyances
A closing segment of second thoughts revisiting and apologizing for previous dark jokes

clips.text: The host describes two prominent conservative figures as compromised lawyers weighed down by bitter ambition and hidden arrogance.
An experienced actor notes that dedicated horror enthusiasts exclusively consume scary films while ignoring his other successful television work.
The conversation shifts from creating ironic distance for dark jokes to comparing the comedic technique directly to the rise of Donald Trump.

clips.hook: Mistaking Johnny Carson for ZZ Top
clips.text: A veteran comedian shares an embarrassing backstage encounter where she failed to recognize the legendary late-night host dressed in a disguise.

clips.hook: Becoming happier while the world gets worse
clips.text: The host reflects on doing hundreds of episodes and realizing that his personal contentment has grown inversely to the worsening state of the world.

beschreibung:
JD Vance and Ted Cruz throw punches, the gerontocracy fights back, and Hunter Biden swings both ways. This week, we have a lively time with The Evil Dead’s Bruce Campbell, who has some strong words for horror fans, rom-coms, and, of all people, Jamie Lee Curtis. Paula Poundstone seizes control of the show, and our audience couldn’t be more thrilled. The Rant Wheel spins us through inconsiderate trail users and constantly having to have things to rant about! And we take a final bow with Second Thoughts.
